description: The Metal Dog in Chinese astrology: personality, Metal element traits, 1970 and 2030 dates and compatibility.
answer: In Chinese astrology, the Metal Dog is the Dog born in a Metal year, one of five versions of the eleventh animal. It combines the Dog's loyalty with Metal's qualities. Metal Dog years between 1924 and 2044 are 1970 and 2030. The Dog's fixed element is Earth.

sections.heading: The Metal Dog personality
paragraphs: Earth generates Metal, and the Dog's fixed element is Earth, so a Metal year draws on the Dog's steady substance to forge a stem of principle and resolve. Metal Dogs are often described as fiercely loyal, principled and determined, with a strong moral compass and the courage to defend it. They tend to be honest, disciplined and protective, willing to stand firm under pressure. Their integrity earns respect. Because energy flows outward into Metal's sharpness, they may become rigid or judgemental, and readings mention a tendency to see situations in black and white, to hold grudges and to struggle with compromise. They can be the most steadfast ally anyone could hope for, and the most unyielding opponent when they believe a line has been crossed.

Belonging to the west and to the clear, cool air of autumn, Metal adds edge, resolve and structure to any sign it colours. Classical texts connect it with righteousness, strength of will and the ability to see a situation without sentiment. A Metal stem often makes an animal more ambitious, more organised and more self-contained than usual. People born in Metal years are frequently described as loyal to their word and tireless once committed. The caution most readings add is a hardness that can isolate them, along with perfectionism and a reluctance to admit doubt or ask for help.

sections.heading: Metal Dog at work and in love
paragraphs: At work, Metal is usually linked with discipline, precision and principled leadership. Metal-year people are often described as the ones who set standards, cut through confusion and finish what they start, which suits law, engineering, finance, surgery, editing and any role that values exactness. They tend to work well alone and lead by example. The traditional caution is inflexibility: a Metal stem can dismiss ideas that arrive untidily, so practising curiosity before judgement usually makes them better leaders.

The Metal Dog guards principles the way other signs guard property. Compliance, security, judicial administration, regulation and investigative work are typical callings, since a clear code and the nerve to enforce it are needed there. It is tireless once committed and openly uncomfortable with grey areas, so employers who state their values plainly earn its fierce dedication. In close bonds the Metal Dog is steadfast, honest and protective, the friend who never forgets a promise or a confidence. It asks for absolute trust and plain speaking. Clashes generally come from moral rigidity: it may treat a loved one's small white lie as a serious breach and find forgiveness slower than the other person would like.

sections.heading: Metal Dog years and dates
paragraphs: Metal Dog years in the Lunar New Year table run from February 6, 1970 to January 26, 1971 and from February 3, 2030 to January 22, 2031. Because the year begins at Lunar New Year, a birthday in January or early February needs checking: in 1970 anyone born before Feb 6 is a Earth Rooster, not a Metal Dog. Sixty years separate each Metal Dog year, the length of a full round of five elements and twelve animals. Every Metal Dog year is Yang, matching the Dog's own polarity.

Its traditional name is Geng-Xu: Geng is the yang Metal stem and Xu is the Dog's branch. Births just before each new year fall in the Earth Rooster year (before February 6, 1970) and the Earth Rooster year (before February 3, 2030), and births in the weeks after each Metal Dog year ends belong to the Metal Pig. The new year itself fell on a Friday in 1970 and Sunday in 2030.

sections.heading: Growth edges and compatibility for the Metal Dog
paragraphs: Metal Dogs often grow by allowing shades of grey. Recognising that people can be well-meaning and mistaken at the same time softens judgement and preserves relationships. Forgiveness, even partial, frees energy that grudges consume. Metal Dogs often thrive in roles demanding integrity and courage, such as law, protection or principled leadership. Physical discipline, such as martial arts or long hikes, suits their temperament. Expressing affection openly, not just through loyalty, helps loved ones feel it. When principle is joined with compassion, Metal Dogs become respected and deeply trusted figures. A trusted friend who can tease them gently is worth a great deal.

For relationships, the classical structures belong to the animal rather than the element, so the Metal Dog shares the Dog's San He trine with the Tiger and Horse (the Fire trine), its Liu He bond with the Rabbit, and its Liu Chong clash with the Dragon. The element adds a second layer: another Metal sign shares this year element, while partners whose year element feeds Metal in the generating cycle are often described as supportive.

faq.question: What years are Metal Dog years?
faq.answer: Between 1924 and 2044: 1970 (from February 6, 1970) and 2030 (from February 3, 2030). Each lasts until the day before the next Lunar New Year.

faq.question: What is the Metal Dog's element relationship?
faq.answer: The year element is Metal and the Dog's fixed element is Earth; in the five-element cycles earth generates Metal. Readings use that relationship to describe how easily the two sides of the sign sit together.

faq.question: Which animals are most compatible with the Metal Dog?
faq.answer: Traditionally the Tiger and Horse (San He) and the Rabbit (Liu He). The Dragon is the Liu Chong clash. These pairings depend on the animal, whatever the element.

faq.question: What is the Metal Dog called in the Chinese calendar?
faq.answer: Geng-Xu. In almanacs and Four Pillars charts each year is named by its heavenly stem, here the Metal stem Geng, followed by its earthly branch, here Xu for the Dog, so the name pins down both halves of the combination at once.

faq.question: How is the Metal Dog different from other Dogs?
faq.answer: All Dogs share loyalty, fairness and protectiveness. The Metal year element changes the tone: metal is the element of autumn and harvest, and a Metal year is traditionally said to sharpen whatever animal it meets.
